--- sbatch omp2_two_nodes
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=wtrun-x-s0
#SBATCH -p compute -N 2 --exclusive --ntasks-per-node=72 --time=01:30:00 --exclude=head
#SBATCH --signal=B:USR1@90
#SBATCH --no-requeue
#SBATCH --output=<TMP>/seg dir/segment-%j.out
set -uo pipefail
SEG='<TMP>/seg dir'
SITE=scc
CAMPAIGN=${CAMPAIGN:-/repo/campaign}
source "$CAMPAIGN/sites/$SITE.sh"   # site_env / site_launch / site_hygiene / W
source "$HOME/wtune-scc/env.sh"
ulimit -s unlimited
export WTUNE_ENV_SOURCE="$HOME/wtune-scc/env.sh"
site_env
W=${WRF_TREE:-$W}
ALLOC_NODES=${SLURM_JOB_NUM_NODES:-2}
STATUS="$SEG/segment_status.txt"
: > "$STATUS"

run_hygiene() {
  site_hygiene "$1"
  timeout 90 "${SITE_HYGIENE_CMD[@]}" 2>&1 || true
}

WRF_PID=""
CUR_WINDOW=""
kill_and_reap() {
  if [ -n "$WRF_PID" ] && kill -0 "$WRF_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -TERM "$WRF_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 3
    kill -0 "$WRF_PID" 2>/dev/null && kill -KILL "$WRF_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  pkill -u "$USER" -x real.exe 2>/dev/null; pkill -u "$USER" -x wrf.exe 2>/dev/null
  run_hygiene reap
}

SIGNAL_TRAP_DONE=0
on_signal() {
  local sig="$1"
  [ "$SIGNAL_TRAP_DONE" = 1 ] && return 0
  SIGNAL_TRAP_DONE=1
  kill_and_reap
  if [ -n "$CUR_WINDOW" ]; then
    echo "SEGMENT $CUR_WINDOW rc=1 ok=0 INTERRUPTED sig=$sig" >> "$STATUS"
  fi
  exit 3
}
on_exit() {
  [ "$SIGNAL_TRAP_DONE" = 1 ] && return 0
  run_hygiene reap
}
trap 'on_signal USR1' USR1
trap 'on_signal TERM' TERM
trap 'on_signal INT' INT
trap on_exit EXIT

run_hygiene reap+census

cd "$SEG"
TBL_CACHE="${WTUNE_TABLE_CACHE:-$HOME/wtune-runs/thompson_tables}/$(readlink -f "$W/main/wrf.exe" | sha1sum | cut -c1-16)"
shopt -s nullglob; for f in "$TBL_CACHE"/qr_acr_q*.dat "$TBL_CACHE"/freezeH2O.dat; do [ -e "$(basename "$f")" ] || ln -s "$f" .; done; shopt -u nullglob
for f in "$W"/run/*; do
  b=$(basename "$f")
  case "$b" in namelist.input|namelist.output|wrfout*|wrfinput*|wrfbdy*|wrfrst*|rsl.*) ;;
    *) [ -e "$b" ] || ln -sf "$f" "$b" ;; esac
done
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
unset KMP_BLOCKTIME
export OMP_PLACES=cores OMP_PROC_BIND=close
CUR_WINDOW=0
T0=$(date +%s)
site_launch 72 36 2 block
"${SITE_LAUNCH_CMD[@]}" &
WRF_PID=$!
wait "$WRF_PID"; rc=$?
WRF_PID=""; CUR_WINDOW=""
wall=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
ok=$(grep -c 'SUCCESS COMPLETE WRF' rsl.error.0000 2>/dev/null); ok=${ok:-0}
echo "SEGMENT rc=$rc wall=$wall ok=$ok" | tee -a "$STATUS"
if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$ok" -gt 0 ]; then
  shopt -s nullglob; for f in qr_acr_q*.dat freezeH2O.dat; do
    [ -L "$f" ] || [ -e "$TBL_CACHE/$f" ] || { mkdir -p "$TBL_CACHE" && cp -f "$f" "$TBL_CACHE/.$f.$$" && mv -f "$TBL_CACHE/.$f.$$" "$TBL_CACHE/$f"; }
  done; shopt -u nullglob
fi

--- sbatch omp1_cyclic_default_campaign
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=wtrun-x-s3
#SBATCH -p compute -N 2 --exclusive --ntasks-per-node=72 --time=01:30:00 --exclude=head
#SBATCH --signal=B:USR1@90
#SBATCH --no-requeue
#SBATCH --output=<TMP>/seg dir/segment-%j.out
set -uo pipefail
SEG='<TMP>/seg dir'
SITE=scc
CAMPAIGN=${CAMPAIGN:-<REPO>/campaign}
source "$CAMPAIGN/sites/$SITE.sh"   # site_env / site_launch / site_hygiene / W
source "/opt/env.sh"
ulimit -s unlimited
export WTUNE_ENV_SOURCE="/opt/env.sh"
site_env
W=${WRF_TREE:-$W}
ALLOC_NODES=${SLURM_JOB_NUM_NODES:-2}
STATUS="$SEG/segment_status.txt"
: > "$STATUS"

run_hygiene() {
  site_hygiene "$1"
  timeout 90 "${SITE_HYGIENE_CMD[@]}" 2>&1 || true
}

WRF_PID=""
CUR_WINDOW=""
kill_and_reap() {
  if [ -n "$WRF_PID" ] && kill -0 "$WRF_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -TERM "$WRF_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 3
    kill -0 "$WRF_PID" 2>/dev/null && kill -KILL "$WRF_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  pkill -u "$USER" -x real.exe 2>/dev/null; pkill -u "$USER" -x wrf.exe 2>/dev/null
  run_hygiene reap
}

SIGNAL_TRAP_DONE=0
on_signal() {
  local sig="$1"
  [ "$SIGNAL_TRAP_DONE" = 1 ] && return 0
  SIGNAL_TRAP_DONE=1
  kill_and_reap
  if [ -n "$CUR_WINDOW" ]; then
    echo "SEGMENT $CUR_WINDOW rc=1 ok=0 INTERRUPTED sig=$sig" >> "$STATUS"
  fi
  exit 3
}
on_exit() {
  [ "$SIGNAL_TRAP_DONE" = 1 ] && return 0
  run_hygiene reap
}
trap 'on_signal USR1' USR1
trap 'on_signal TERM' TERM
trap 'on_signal INT' INT
trap on_exit EXIT

run_hygiene reap+census

cd "$SEG"
TBL_CACHE="${WTUNE_TABLE_CACHE:-$HOME/wtune-runs/thompson_tables}/$(readlink -f "$W/main/wrf.exe" | sha1sum | cut -c1-16)"
shopt -s nullglob; for f in "$TBL_CACHE"/qr_acr_q*.dat "$TBL_CACHE"/freezeH2O.dat; do [ -e "$(basename "$f")" ] || ln -s "$f" .; done; shopt -u nullglob
for f in "$W"/run/*; do
  b=$(basename "$f")
  case "$b" in namelist.input|namelist.output|wrfout*|wrfinput*|wrfbdy*|wrfrst*|rsl.*) ;;
    *) [ -e "$b" ] || ln -sf "$f" "$b" ;; esac
done
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
unset KMP_BLOCKTIME
unset OMP_PLACES OMP_PROC_BIND
CUR_WINDOW=3
T0=$(date +%s)
site_launch 130 65 1 cyclic
"${SITE_LAUNCH_CMD[@]}" &
WRF_PID=$!
wait "$WRF_PID"; rc=$?
WRF_PID=""; CUR_WINDOW=""
wall=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
ok=$(grep -c 'SUCCESS COMPLETE WRF' rsl.error.0000 2>/dev/null); ok=${ok:-0}
echo "SEGMENT rc=$rc wall=$wall ok=$ok" | tee -a "$STATUS"
if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$ok" -gt 0 ]; then
  shopt -s nullglob; for f in qr_acr_q*.dat freezeH2O.dat; do
    [ -L "$f" ] || [ -e "$TBL_CACHE/$f" ] || { mkdir -p "$TBL_CACHE" && cp -f "$f" "$TBL_CACHE/.$f.$$" && mv -f "$TBL_CACHE/.$f.$$" "$TBL_CACHE/$f"; }
  done; shopt -u nullglob
fi
